resources.string: Move slowly to help locate your case.
Root access is ready. The case connection is still being developed.
Allow LibrePods root access in your root manager to connect to the AirPods case. Precision Finding is still under development.
Root access is unavailable. Enable root for LibrePods in your root manager, then try again.
Root access granted. The Bluetooth access check could not finish. Try again.
Root access granted. This phone still restricts the Bluetooth connection needed for the case.
Root access granted. Bluetooth access checks passed. Case connection and ranging still need testing.
Connect your Apple Account for Find My. Sign-in communicates directly with Apple. Your password is never saved; your session is encrypted on this device.
Choose where to receive your verification code.
AirPods enrollment and Precision Finding are still under development. Connecting your account does not enroll AirPods in this build.
Apple requires you to review and accept updated account terms before continuing.
